model.limitations: Generic five-pin educational macromodel with differential input resistance, midpoint-centered soft voltage limiting, finite output resistance, bounded active output current, supply-dependent enable and explicit supply currents. A declared 1 Gohm output-to-V- bleed remains with power off or reversed; differential input resistance also remains. No internal bandwidth, slew rate, offset/bias mismatch, common-mode restrictions, protection diodes, noise, thermal behavior, ratings or named physical device. External storage supplies circuit timing; this model cannot qualify physical amplifier speed or stability.
